gloss: to writhe, to suffer agony, to agonize

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {悶|もだ}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to writhe in pain, to suffer agony
definitions.explanation: To twist and turn one's body due to intense physical pain or emotional distress.
To suffer intense emotional distress such as frustration, longing, or jealousy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}える
{苦|くる}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}え⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent the night writhing in agony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れて→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧{悶|もだ}えた。
examples.english: I collapsed on the floor writhing from stomach pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嫉妬|しっと}→嫉妬：05406_shitto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}える
⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}える⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧
examples.english: a young person tormented by love

examples.japanese: ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}え⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: I kept agonizing over a problem with no answer.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Uses ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ particle for cause: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}える.

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb: {悶|もだ}えない, {悶|もだ}えます, {悶|もだ}えて, {悶|もだ}えれば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧/⟦{苦|くる}しみ→苦しみ：14120_kurushimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}える (to writhe in pain/agony)
- ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧/⟦{嫉妬|しっと}→嫉妬：05406_shitto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶|もだ}える (to be tormented by love/jealousy)
- {悶|もだ}え{苦|くる}しむ (to suffer in agony - compound verb)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{身悶|みもだ}える→身悶える：09138_mimodaeru⟧ (to writhe - emphasizes whole body)
- ⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ (to suffer - more general)
- ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ (to worry, be troubled - less intense)
